# Dedicated Compute Overview
Source: https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/compute/dedicated-overview
Fetched: 2026-06-16
Last updated on page: Jun 11, 2026

## What is dedicated compute?
"Dedicated compute is compute configured with dedicated access mode. This means the compute resource can only be used by the single user or group assigned to it."

## Access mode selection
Access mode configured in Advanced section during compute creation.
Default: Auto — "defaults to Standard unless a machine learning runtime or a Databricks Runtimes lower than 14.3 is selected, in which case Dedicated is used."

## When to use dedicated compute
Choose dedicated compute for workloads requiring:
- RDD APIs — direct access to Spark's Resilient Distributed Dataset APIs
- GPU instances — access to GPU resources
- R language support — R programming capabilities for data science
- Privileged machine access — lower-level system resource access
"Use standard compute for better cost efficiency and simplified management" for other use cases.

## User and group assignment
- Single user assignment: "Assign compute to one specific user for exclusive access."
- Group assignment (Public Preview): "Assign compute to a single group for shared access within the group."

## Limitations and considerations
"Fine-grain access control functionality requires Databricks Runtime 15.4 LTS or above and serverless compute enablement."
